ascii_lines_before = current_frame.ascii.split('\n')

def get_pink_pattern(col, lines):
    pat = []
    for r in range(52, 57):
        row = []
        for c in range(col, col + 5):
            row.append('B' if lines[r][c] == 'B' else '.')

print("\nPink patterns after UP:")
for c in pink_cols:
    print(f"  P{pink_cols.index(c)} (col {c}):")
    print(f"    {pats_after[c]}")

# Check which changed
print("\nChanged:")
